platform-reference 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides a comprehensive reference for 15 BulkPublish platforms (plus Reddit, currently switched off).
- Details post types, media requirements, required fields, character limits, and platformSpecific options for each platform.
- Includes critical usage notes and quick rules to prevent common errors (e.g., media requirements for YouTube, TikTok, and Pinterest).
- Serves as a required reference before creating any posts in BulkPublish.
